requirements.title: Reading the sandbox configuration section
requirements.rationale: The sandbox definition must come from the same file the operator already maintains, and a mistyped key at a security boundary must not be dropped silently.

criteria.condition: hub starts
criteria.action: read the [sandbox] table and every [[sandbox.profiles]] table from $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/config.toml when XDG_CONFIG_HOME is set and non-empty, and from ./config.toml otherwise
criteria.contract: the loader returns the decoded sandbox configuration with every profile in file order

setup: a temp dir A with config.toml holding [sandbox] provider="podman" and profiles "zeta" then "alpha"
a temp dir B with a different config.toml in the working directory
check.pseudocode: t.Setenv('XDG_CONFIG_HOME',A); cfg=LoadConfig(ConfigPath()); assert names(cfg)==['zeta','alpha']; unset; chdir(B); assert ConfigPath()=='./config.toml'

criteria.condition: the config file does not exist or contains no [sandbox] table
criteria.action: treat the feature as off, finish start-up normally and log exactly one info line saying sandboxes are disabled
criteria.contract: the loader returns a nil configuration and a nil error; af-hub serves every existing route unchanged

setup: one case with no config file and one case with a config.toml holding only [server]
a captured slog handler
check.pseudocode: cfg,err=LoadConfig(p); assert cfg==nil && err==nil; assert count(infoRecords)==1 && contains(msg,'disabled')

criteria.action: for any string value in the sandbox section, including list entries and env values, replace each ${NAME} with the value of environment variable NAME (an empty string when NAME is unset), leave every bare $ unchanged, and leave all values outside the sandbox section unexpanded
criteria.contract: every ${NAME} is replaced by the variable's value, or by an empty string when unset; every $ not followed by {NAME} is preserved; the same expansion applies in scalar, list and env-map values

setup: environment variables with random names and values set via t.Setenv, and some left unset
a config.toml where [server] and [workspace] values contain ${HOME_X} and where a sandbox env value contains a quote character and ${SANDBOX_TOKEN}
check.pseudocode:
for s in gen_strings(): cfg=load(toml(s)); assert cfg.image==model_expand(s) for all four positions
cfg=LoadConfig(p); assert cfg.Profiles[0].Env['K']=='q"abc'; assert cfg.Profiles[0].Image=='cost$5'

criteria.condition: a key under [sandbox] or under any [[sandbox.profiles]] entry is not one the loader recognises
criteria.action: refuse start with an error that names the full key path, such as sandbox.profiles[1].memroy_mb
criteria.contract: non-nil error containing the full key path; af-hub exits non-zero before any HTTP listener opens

setup: a config with two profiles where profiles[1] has memroy_mb = 512
a second config with an unknown key sandbox.listenx

criteria.condition: the file or the sections that apikit owns ([server], [database], [workspace], OAuth) contain keys outside the sandbox section
criteria.action: ignore those keys when it detects unknown keys
criteria.contract: no unknown-key error is produced for any key path whose first element is not sandbox

setup: a config.toml with a valid [sandbox] plus [server], [database], [workspace] and OAuth tables containing keys the sandbox package does not know

criteria.condition: the config file exists but cannot be read, or cannot be decoded as TOML
criteria.action: refuse start and include the read or decode error
criteria.contract: non-nil error that wraps the underlying read or toml decode error; af-hub exits non-zero

setup: one path to a file with mode 0000 (or a directory named config.toml) and one file with invalid TOML syntax

criteria.action: load and validate the sandbox section only after apikit.Bootstrap returns, and before any job queue, worker or HTTP route is set up, so that first-boot admin-token generation succeeds even when the sandbox section is invalid
criteria.contract: with an invalid sandbox section, `af-hub --admin-email` still writes the admin token and exits 0; without that flag, af-hub exits non-zero before any queue, worker or route is created

setup: the af-hub binary built from cmd/af-hub
a temp XDG_CONFIG_HOME whose config.toml has an invalid [sandbox] section
a temp database and workspace path, and a free port
check.pseudocode: run(bin,'--admin-email','a@b.c'); assert exit==0 && tokenFile exists; r=run(bin); assert r.exit!=0; assert !dial(port)

requirements.title: Deployment-level sandbox keys
requirements.rationale: Deployment keys pick the provider and set the limits that every profile must stay within.

criteria.condition: the [sandbox] table is present and provider is absent or empty
criteria.action: refuse start with a failure naming sandbox.provider as required
criteria.contract: validation error containing "sandbox.provider"; af-hub exits non-zero

setup: a config with [sandbox] containing one valid profile but no provider, and one with provider = ""

criteria.condition: provider is "gateway"
criteria.action: refuse start with a failure saying the gateway provider is not supported by this build
criteria.contract: validation error containing "sandbox.provider" and "not supported by this build"

setup: configs with provider="gateway" and provider="kubernetes"
check.pseudocode: assert contains(Validate(gw),'not supported by this build'); assert contains(Validate(k8s),'podman')

criteria.condition: provider is a value other than "podman" or "gateway"
criteria.action: refuse start with a failure that names sandbox.provider and lists the accepted values
criteria.contract: validation error containing "sandbox.provider" and "podman"

criteria.condition: engine_binary, runtime or userns is absent from [sandbox]
criteria.action: default engine_binary to "podman" and runtime and userns to "", and pass all three values to the Podman provider options unchanged
criteria.contract: podman.Options{Binary, Runtime, UserNS} equal the configured values, or the defaults when they are absent

setup: a recording provider factory standing in for podman.New
one config with engine_binary="docker", runtime="runsc", userns="keep-id" and one config omitting all three

criteria.condition: max_ttl is present and is not a valid Go duration string or is not greater than zero
criteria.action: refuse start with a failure naming sandbox.max_ttl, and use 4h as max_ttl when the key is absent
criteria.contract: validation error containing "sandbox.max_ttl" for an invalid value; an effective max_ttl of 4h when the key is absent

setup: configs with max_ttl = "soon", "0s", "-1h" and one with max_ttl absent and a profile ttl of 4h

criteria.condition: network_modes contains an empty string or a value that appears more than once
criteria.action: refuse start with a failure naming sandbox.network_modes and the offending index, and use ["none"] as network_modes when the key is absent
criteria.contract: validation error containing "sandbox.network_modes"; an effective network_modes of ["none"] when the key is absent

setup: configs with network_modes ["none",""], ["none","bridge","none"] and one absent

requirements.title: Profile identity, image, resources, network and lifetime
requirements.rationale: Every profile has to describe a shape that hub can create later without guessing.

criteria.condition: the [sandbox] table has no [[sandbox.profiles]] entry
criteria.action: refuse start with a failure saying at least one profile is required
criteria.contract: validation error containing "sandbox.profiles"

setup: a config with provider podman and no [[sandbox.profiles]]

criteria.condition: a profile's name is missing, does not match ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,62}$, or equals the name of an earlier profile
criteria.action: record a failure that names the profile (by name, or as sandbox.profiles[i] when name is missing) and the name field
criteria.contract: validation error containing the profile identifier and "name"

setup: profiles with names: missing (index 0), "Upper", "-lead", a 64-character name, and two profiles named "dev"

criteria.condition: more than one profile sets default = true
criteria.action: record a failure that names the profiles that set default and the default field, and accept a configuration where no profile sets default
criteria.contract: validation error containing "default" when two or more profiles set it; no error when none do

setup: three configs: two profiles with default=true, one with default=true, none with default

criteria.condition: a profile's image is missing or is an empty string
criteria.action: record a failure naming the profile and the image field
criteria.contract: validation error containing the profile identifier and "image"

setup: profile "a" without image and profile "b" with image = ""

criteria.condition: a profile's cpus is negative, or its memory_mb, pids or disk_mb is negative or not an integer
criteria.action: record a failure naming the profile and the resource field, and accept 0 in every resource field as the provider's default
criteria.contract: validation error containing the profile identifier and the resource field name; 0 values pass

setup: profiles with cpus=-1, memory_mb=-5, pids=1.5, disk_mb=-1 and a profile with all four set to 0
check.pseudocode: for f in [cpus,memory_mb,pids,disk_mb]: assert contains(err, profile+' '+f)

criteria.condition: a profile's network, after defaulting an absent value to "none", is not one of network_modes
criteria.action: record a failure naming the profile, the network field and the rejected mode
criteria.contract: validation error containing the profile identifier and "network"

setup: network_modes ["none"] with a profile network="bridge"
a profile with no network key

criteria.condition: a profile's ttl is missing, is not a valid Go duration string, is not greater than zero, or is greater than max_ttl
criteria.action: record a failure naming the profile and the ttl field, and accept a ttl exactly equal to max_ttl
criteria.contract: validation error containing the profile identifier and "ttl"; ttl == max_ttl passes

setup: max_ttl="1h" and profiles with ttl missing, "abc", "0s", "61m", and "1h"

criteria.condition: a profile omits require_landlock
criteria.action: set require_landlock to false for that profile
criteria.contract: the validated profile has RequireLandlock == false

setup: a valid profile without require_landlock and one with require_landlock=true

requirements.title: Secret and environment names, and collected failures
requirements.rationale: Profile secret names must be keys the secrets store can hold, which compares them without regard to case. An operator should see every fault after a single restart.

criteria.condition: an entry of a profile's secrets or optional_secrets fails secrets.ValidateKey
criteria.action: record a failure naming the profile, the list field and the entry index
criteria.contract: validation error containing the profile identifier and "secrets" or "optional_secrets"

setup: a profile with secrets ["OK","1BAD"] and optional_secrets ["has-dash"]

criteria.condition: two names in a profile's secrets and optional_secrets are equal when compared ignoring case, within one list or across the two lists
criteria.action: record a failure naming the profile and the repeated name
criteria.contract: validation error containing the profile identifier and the duplicate name

setup: profile with secrets ["API_KEY","api_key"]
profile with secrets ["TOKEN"] and optional_secrets ["token"]

criteria.action: accept reserved secret names such as GIT_PAT in secrets and optional_secrets when they pass secrets.ValidateKey
criteria.contract: no error is returned

setup: a profile with secrets ["GIT_PAT"] and optional_secrets ["GH_TOKEN"]

criteria.condition: a key of a profile's env fails secrets.ValidateKey
criteria.action: record a failure naming the profile, the env field and the key, but not the value
criteria.contract: validation error containing the profile identifier, "env" and the key

setup: a profile with env {"BAD-KEY":"supersecretvalue"}

criteria.condition: a key of a profile's env equals, ignoring case, a name in the same profile's secrets or optional_secrets
criteria.action: record a failure naming the profile, the env field and the key, but not the value
criteria.contract: validation error containing the profile identifier and the colliding key

setup: a profile with secrets ["GIT_PAT"] and env {"git_pat":"leakme"}, and another with optional_secrets ["X"] and env {"x":"leakme"}

criteria.action: for any sandbox section with N independent static faults across the deployment keys and the profiles, return one error that contains all N failure messages, not only the first
criteria.contract: one joined error whose text contains each of the N failure messages

setup: a catalogue of independent fault injectors (bad max_ttl, bad network_modes, bad name, duplicate name, missing image, negative resource, bad ttl, bad secret, env collision)
check.pseudocode: for subset in gen_subsets(): err=Validate(apply(subset)); for f in subset: assert contains(err,f.expected)

requirements.title: Provider construction and capability check
requirements.rationale: Hub must know at start that the engine is reachable and that the provider can honour every profile, without creating anything.

criteria.condition: static validation of the sandbox section passes
criteria.action: build the Podman provider from engine_binary, runtime and userns and call its List method exactly once with a 10-second timeout
criteria.contract: exactly one List call, whose context has a deadline no more than 10 seconds away

setup: a valid config and a test-double provider that records List contexts and advertises network mode none
check.pseudocode: New(cfg,fake); assert fake.listCalls==1; assert fake.deadline - callTime <= 10s

criteria.condition: static validation of the sandbox section fails
criteria.action: report the static failures without building the provider or calling List
criteria.contract: validation error returned; the provider has zero List calls

setup: a config with a duplicate profile name and a recording provider factory and double

criteria.condition: building the provider fails, or the List probe returns an error or exceeds its 10-second timeout
criteria.action: refuse start with an error that starts with "sandbox:", names sandbox.provider and sandbox.engine_binary, and includes the provider's error text
criteria.contract: non-nil error containing "sandbox:", "sandbox.provider", "sandbox.engine_binary" and the provider error; af-hub exits non-zero

setup: a factory returning an error, a double whose List returns 'engine down', and a double whose List blocks until its context is done

criteria.condition: a network_modes entry is not among the network modes in the provider's capabilities
criteria.action: refuse start with a failure naming sandbox.network_modes and the unsupported mode
criteria.contract: non-nil error containing "sandbox.network_modes" and the mode

setup: network_modes ["none","host"] and a double whose capabilities list only none

criteria.condition: the probe succeeds
criteria.action: turn each profile into a sandbox.Spec carrying the image, only the profile's fixed env, the network, the resources, TTL equal to the profile's ttl and RequireLandlock, and check that spec with sandbox.CheckSpec against the provider's capabilities
criteria.contract: one CheckSpec call per profile; the Spec env contains no secret names

setup: two profiles with secrets ["GIT_PAT"], optional_secrets ["X"] and env {"LANG":"C"}, a double recording the Spec seen by CheckSpec (or the real CheckSpec against double capabilities)

criteria.condition: sandbox.CheckSpec returns an error for a profile
criteria.action: refuse start with a failure that names the profile and includes the CheckSpec error text
criteria.contract: non-nil error containing the profile name and the CheckSpec error text

setup: a double whose capabilities reject profile "big" (for example require_landlock unsupported) and accept profile "small"

criteria.condition: AgentKit's CPU resource field is a whole-number type and a profile's cpus has a fractional part
criteria.action: refuse start with a failure naming the profile and the cpus field
criteria.contract: non-nil error containing the profile name and "cpus"

setup: a profile with cpus = 1.5 and a valid double provider
AgentKit's CPU field type checked at implementation time; if it is a float the case is skipped and 1.5 passes

criteria.action: keep the provider and the validated profiles in memory after start, and never call the provider's Create or Destroy method
criteria.contract: the service exposes the provider and the validated profiles; the double records zero Create and zero Destroy calls

setup: a recording double provider and a valid config
check.pseudocode: svc=New(cfg,fake); assert svc.Provider()==fake && len(svc.Profiles())==2; assert fake.create==0 && fake.destroy==0

requirements.title: Sandbox permission scopes
requirements.rationale: PATs must be able to carry sandbox scopes before an operator turns the feature on.

criteria.action: export Permissions() returning exactly the apikit permissions sandboxes:read and sandboxes:write, which af-hub appends to the scopes it registers with apikit on every start, whether the feature is on or off
criteria.contract: Permissions() returns [{sandboxes read} {sandboxes write}]

criteria.action: for any PAT, grant sandbox read access exactly when its permissions contain sandboxes:read or sandboxes:write
criteria.contract: canReadSandboxes is true iff the list contains sandboxes:read or sandboxes:write

check.pseudocode: for perms in gen(): assert canRead(pat(perms)) == ('sandboxes:read' in perms or 'sandboxes:write' in perms)

criteria.action: grant sandbox read access to every api_key and admin_token credential without checking any scope
criteria.contract: canReadSandboxes is true

check.pseudocode: for t in [api_key,admin_token]: for perms in gen(): assert canRead({t,perms})

requirements.title: Profile listing endpoint
requirements.rationale: Callers choose a profile by name and see its shape. The routes always exist, so a caller can tell a disabled feature apart from a mistyped path.

criteria.condition: GET /api/v1/sandbox-profiles arrives with no credential
criteria.action: reject the request before checking whether the feature is on
criteria.contract: HTTP 401 in apikit's error envelope

setup: the route registered once with a nil service (disabled) and once with a service, no auth middleware setting AuthInfo

criteria.condition: the feature is off
criteria.action: answer every authenticated request, including one from a PAT without sandbox scopes, with error_type sandboxes_disabled and the message "sandboxes are not enabled on this hub"
criteria.contract: HTTP 404 with body {"error":{"code":404,"message":"sandboxes are not enabled on this hub","error_type":"sandboxes_disabled"}}

setup: routes registered with a nil service
callers: admin_token, api_key, and a PAT with no sandbox scopes

criteria.condition: the feature is on and the caller is a PAT with neither sandboxes:read nor sandboxes:write
criteria.action: reject the request through apikit.WriteAPIError
criteria.contract: HTTP 403 in apikit's error envelope

setup: routes registered with a valid service
a PAT holding only secrets:list

criteria.condition: an authorised caller requests GET /api/v1/sandbox-profiles while the feature is on
criteria.action: return every validated profile, sorted by name, each with name, default, image, network, ttl_seconds, resources {cpus, memory_mb, pids, disk_mb}, secrets, optional_secrets, env_keys and require_landlock
criteria.contract: HTTP 200 with body {"profiles":[...]}, where ttl_seconds is a JSON integer equal to the ttl in whole seconds

setup: a service with profiles "zeta" (ttl 90m, default, cpus 1, memory_mb 512, pids 100, disk_mb 0) and "alpha"
an admin_token caller
check.pseudocode: assert names==['alpha','zeta']; assert p.ttl_seconds==5400; assert keys(p)==expected

criteria.action: for any profile, render secrets, optional_secrets and env_keys sorted in ascending order and as JSON arrays, with an empty array rather than null when a list has no entries
criteria.contract: each of secrets, optional_secrets and env_keys is a JSON array; each array is sorted in ascending order; an empty list renders as [] and not null

check.pseudocode: for p in gen(): body=get(); for f in lists: assert isArray(body[f]) && body[f]==sorted(body[f])

criteria.condition: the feature is on
criteria.action: build the response only from the validated profiles in memory, without calling the provider or reading the database, so it still answers 200 after the engine becomes unreachable
criteria.contract: HTTP 200 with zero provider calls during the request

setup: a service built with a double that counts every method call after start
the handler wired without any database handle
the double afterwards set to fail all calls
check.pseudocode: fake.failAll(); fake.reset(); rec=get(); assert rec.Code==200 && fake.total()==0

criteria.action: return the same profile list to every authorised caller, whatever their workspaces, user or organisation
criteria.contract: the response body bytes are identical for all callers

setup: a service with a fixed set of profiles
check.pseudocode: base=get(admin).Body; for c in gen_callers(): assert get(c).Body==base

requirements.title: No secret or environment value leaves hub
requirements.rationale: ${VAR} expansion can put an operator credential into env, and callers must never see secret values or the provider.

criteria.action: for any sandbox section, never include an env value in the profile listing body, the start-up log lines or any validation error
criteria.contract: none of the configured env values appears as a substring of the listing body, any log record or any returned error

setup: a captured slog handler and a unique random sentinel as each env value
check.pseudocode: for cfg in gen(): err,logs,body=run(cfg); for v in envValues(cfg): assert v not in err+logs+body

criteria.condition: hub starts with the feature on
criteria.action: log exactly one info line that gives the provider name and the profile names and no other value from the sandbox section
criteria.contract: one slog info record whose attributes are only the provider name and the list of profile names

setup: a captured slog handler, a valid config whose image, secrets and env values are distinctive strings

criteria.action: build its configuration, validation and listing without a secrets.Store or database handle, so that no secret value is read in this scope, and never include the provider name, its options or max_ttl in the listing body
criteria.contract: the body contains none of podman-x, runsc, 'podman', max_ttl or 3h; the exported constructors and loaders compile without a *secrets.Store or *sql.DB parameter

setup: a config with provider podman, engine_binary "/opt/podman-x", runtime "runsc", max_ttl "3h"
check.pseudocode: assert !contains(body,'runsc') && !contains(body,'max_ttl'); New(cfg, provider) compiles with no db

requirements.title: afc sandbox profiles command
requirements.rationale: Operators and agents read the deployment's profiles from the CLI they already use.

criteria.condition: a user runs `afc sandbox profiles`
criteria.action: send GET /api/v1/sandbox-profiles with the configured credential and print the response through apikit.CLIPrintResult
criteria.contract: one JSON document on stdout equal to the response body; exit code 0

setup: an httptest hub answering GET /api/v1/sandbox-profiles with a fixed profiles JSON body and recording the Authorization header

criteria.condition: `afc sandbox profiles` is given one or more positional arguments
criteria.action: reject the invocation without sending any request
criteria.contract: non-zero exit with a usage error on stderr; zero HTTP requests

setup: an httptest hub counting requests

criteria.condition: the hub answers with an error status, including 404 sandboxes_disabled, 401 or 403
criteria.action: report the error through apikit.CLIHandleError
criteria.contract: error message on stderr, nothing on stdout, and the non-zero exit code that apikit maps to the status

setup: an httptest hub answering 404 with error_type sandboxes_disabled, then 401, then 403 in apikit's envelope
check.pseudocode: for s in [404,401,403]: out,err=run(...); assert out=='' && ExitCode(err)==apikitCode(s)

criteria.action: register an `afc sandbox` command group in BuildRootCommand whose only subcommand is profiles
criteria.contract: a command named sandbox exists; its subcommands are exactly [profiles]

requirements.title: AgentKit dependency and import boundary
requirements.rationale: hub's build has to reach the agentkit-go sibling the way it reaches apikit, while afc stays a static binary.

criteria.action: require the agentkit-go sandbox module in go.mod, with a replace directive pointing at ../agentkit-go next to the existing apikit replace
criteria.contract: go.mod has a require for the agentkit-go sandbox module and a replace to ../agentkit-go next to the apikit replace; the Containerfile copies from the agentkit build context; the build-hub-container target passes --build-context agentkit=../agentkit-go; inc-build-hub.yaml and build-hub-cli.yaml clone agentkit-go and inc-build-hub.yaml passes it as a build context

setup: go.mod, containers/hub/Containerfile, Makefile and the two workflow files read as text

criteria.action: keep internal/sandboxes and every agentkit-go package out of the transitive imports of cmd/afc and internal/cli, so that afc builds with CGO_ENABLED=0
criteria.contract: `go list -deps ./cmd/afc` lists no internal/sandboxes or agentkit-go package

setup: the repository module graph

criteria.action: make the agentkit-go sibling available to container and CI builds: containers/hub/Containerfile copies it from an agentkit build context, the build-hub-container target in the Makefile passes --build-context agentkit=../agentkit-go, inc-build-hub.yaml and build-hub-cli.yaml clone it next to the repository, and inc-build-hub.yaml passes it as a build context

execution_paths.title: Hub starts with a valid sandbox section and a caller lists profiles over REST

steps.action: starts af-hub with a config.toml containing [sandbox] provider = "podman" and two [[sandbox.profiles]] entries
runs apikit.Bootstrap, then loads the sandbox section, expands ${NAME} values and validates the keys and profiles
builds the Podman provider (an injected test double in tests), probes it with one List call, checks network_modes and runs sandbox.CheckSpec on every profile
registers sandboxes:read and sandboxes:write, mounts GET /api/v1/sandbox-profiles and logs one info line with the provider and profile names
sends GET /api/v1/sandbox-profiles with a PAT that holds sandboxes:read
returns 200 with {"profiles":[...]} sorted by name, carrying secret names and env key names but no values

setup: a temp XDG_CONFIG_HOME config.toml with provider podman and two profiles using ${NAME} env values and secret names
a test-double sandbox.Provider with network mode none that records calls
an echo server with a test auth middleware
end_state: start succeeds with exactly one List call and one CheckSpec per profile
the start-up info log has provider and profile names only
the response is 200 sorted by name with secret names and env key names
no env value appears in the body
smoke.pseudocode: cfg=LoadConfig(ConfigPath()); svc=New(cfg,fake); RegisterRoutes(api,svc); rec=get(pat(['sandboxes:read'])); assert 200 and sorted and no env values

execution_paths.title: An operator lists profiles with afc

steps.action: runs `afc sandbox profiles` with an API key
returns 200 with the validated profiles from memory
prints the response as one JSON document on stdout and exits 0

setup: an httptest server hosting the real sandboxes route over a service built with a double provider
the real cli.BuildRootCommand, run from an internal/sandboxes test package
end_state: stdout is one JSON document equal to the handler's body

execution_paths.title: An invalid sandbox section refuses start

steps.action: starts af-hub with a config.toml whose profiles contain an unknown key, a duplicate name and a ttl over max_ttl
collects every failure, each naming the profile and the field, without building or probing the provider
exits non-zero with the joined error before any queue, worker or HTTP route is set up

setup: a config.toml with an unknown profile key, a duplicate profile name and a ttl over max_ttl
the af-hub binary with a fake engine_binary that records invocations to a file
end_state: the process exits non-zero before any HTTP listener opens
stderr contains the unknown key path, the duplicate name with name, and the ttl field with the profile name
the engine binary was never invoked

execution_paths.title: Hub without a sandbox section answers sandboxes_disabled

steps.action: starts af-hub with a config.toml that has no [sandbox] table
logs that sandboxes are disabled, registers both sandbox scopes and mounts the sandbox routes in disabled mode
sends GET /api/v1/sandbox-profiles with a valid credential
returns 404 with error_type sandboxes_disabled and the message "sandboxes are not enabled on this hub"

setup: a config.toml with no [sandbox] table
the real start-up wiring with sandboxes.Permissions() appended and routes registered in disabled mode
end_state: one info line says sandboxes are disabled
the sandboxes:read and sandboxes:write scopes are registered
the response is 404 with error_type sandboxes_disabled and message 'sandboxes are not enabled on this hub'
